presets.name: Simple PLS
presets.description: Three classic preprocessing choices, KFold, and a single n_components sweep for PLS.

presets.name: Fast Result
presets.description: Quick SPXY-oriented preset with simple preprocessing, AOM-PLS, and TabPFN for fast first results.

presets.name: Simple Trees / Boosting
presets.description: Same lightweight preprocessing pattern as Simple PLS, with LightGBM and RandomForest sweeps.

presets.name: Complex PLS
presets.description: Benchmark-style cartesian preprocessing with fixed PLS, tuned PLS, tuned Ridge, and AOM-PLS.

presets.name: Complex Trees
presets.description: Cartesian preprocessing with LightGBM, RandomForest, and XGBoost tree/boosting grids.

presets.name: Non-Linear Exploration
presets.description: Cartesian preprocessing with LightGBM, XGBoost, NICON, and TabPFN for broad non-linear screening.

presets.name: Ultra PLS
presets.description: Large cartesian chemometric exploration with PLS, OPLS, IKPLS-style linear models, and tuned Ridge.

presets.name: Ultra Trees
presets.description: Bigger preprocessing search with tuned LightGBM, RandomForest, XGBoost, ExtraTrees, and GradientBoosting.

presets.name: Deep Non-Linear Exploration
presets.description: Large cartesian preprocessing with tuned gradient-boosted trees, tuned NICON, and TabPFN.

presets.name: Ultra Slow
presets.description: Heavy Cartesian preset mixing tuned PLS, tuned Ridge, tuned AOM-PLS, tuned LightGBM, and TabPFN.
